ns2:section.sectionText: This course explores what it means to build wealth, to be a good steward of wealth – for yourself and for others, and what it means to create and sustain generational wealth. In this class, we will address the question, how do you keep money and make it work for you, your family, and the causes you care about? The FIN 300 prerequisite is waived for business minors, but students must be enrolled, or have completed, FIN 221 before enrolling in this course. This online section is restricted to declared Business Minor students. Gies Study Abroad students should contact the Study Abroad office for permission to register. Day1Access course materials cost $59.75. For more information see https://go.illinois.edu/Day1Access.
